label: unit or subsidiary of
definition: The first organization is an owned subsidiary, division, or organizational unit of the second.
scope_notes: The dominant unit/subsidiary/owned-by dictionary has the same meaning as rel_250; different learned relation IDs do not require different invented predicates. Membership, speech, employment and completed deal descriptions without containment are not automatically equivalent.

facts.reason: American Airlines is repeatedly called a unit/subsidiary of AMR and owned by AMR.
Two direct unit-of rows establish American as an AMR unit. The company apposition alone is less specific.
Fallon is explicitly a unit of Publicis, with agency-part evidence agreeing.
House members described as Democrats express political membership/affiliation, not the House being a subsidiary of Democrats.
The path concerns a State Department spokesman saying something and a WASHINGTON argument; it does not establish organizational containment.
